summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around the hypothesis that enterprise AI deployment shifts bottlenecks toward identity governance, machine/AI-agent permissions, data security posture, observability, and automated incident control. The list uses PANW only as a reference anchor because its Idira/CyberArk platform defines the obvious large-cap framing. The underfollowed lane emphasizes purer or smaller public assets that may benefit second-order from AI governance and control-layer complexity: SailPoint for identity governance across human, machine and AI-agent identities; Varonis for AI/data security posture; PagerDuty for AI-era digital operations and incident automation; and PDF Solutions as a speculative shadow candidate for secure data-orchestration/control in semiconductor manufacturing ecosystems.
